long_description:
Participate in a one-hour yoga class with Dancing Lotus Yoga + Art on select Saturdays on the front lawn, or indoors, at Mint Museum Randolph (weather permitting). Classes are free for Mint members and $10 for nonmembers. During the winter months, this class will be hosted inside Mint Museum Randolph. Members, please contact Alex Gutierrez Mendez, Membership Services Manager, for the online code for free yoga at YWxleCAhIGd1dGllcnJleiB8IG1pbnRtdXNldW0gISBvcmc=.

Registration is required. 

You may also like the following events from The Mint Museum:Next Wednesday, 19th August, 06:00 pm, Caravaggio: A Life on the Edge, public talk with Todd Herman, PhD in CharlotteNext month, 2nd September, 06:00 pm, The Art of Reading: “Red Brick, Black Mountain, White Clay” in CharlotteNext month, 16th September, 06:00 pm, Let the Music Play: Steinway Residency Series in CharlotteAlso check out other Health & Wellness events in Charlotte, Workshops in Charlotte, Arts events in Charlotte.
